comparison: Report all 44 fixed source/policy combinations across the same 40 asset/date panels; show source-specific registered control, original registered reference, and matched-data control using the same policy. Ranking and selecting on these exposed outcomes is exploratory.
confirmation_requirement: Any selected procedure needs a separately registered fresh-date round and the continuing nominal error budget. These 20 dates cannot count again as unseen confirmation.
decision_rule: argmax of unchanged natural posterior divided by causal estimated class prior. Natural argmax accuracy and natural posterior log loss must remain exactly unchanged.
forecast_history: Current and earlier known noon probabilities, with 60 pseudocounts initialized to the available cumulative same-day label estimate at the first query. Weight is one per observed forecast, with clock-time exponential decay between forecasts.
hybrids: Equal average of same-half-life available-label and forecast estimates.
label_history: Own-asset same-day exact labels from 00:02 UTC, observed quote age <=1000ms, each released only when its actual future_event_time <= query_time. Exponential age uses original decision_time, not delayed release time.
motivation: June 3 exposed a large neutral-regime balanced-decision failure. This family evaluates available same-day label frequencies and forecast marginals. No same-day future labels or unreleased outcomes may enter a decision.
